instruction:
Implement solve(weights,seats). weights is a list of nonnegative integers (bool invalid), seats an integer0..1000 (bool invalid). Allocate exactly seats proportionally by Hamilton largest remainders: floor each exact rational share, then one remaining seat per descending fractional remainder, ties by original index. Zero seats returns zeros, including empty input. Positive seats with zero total weight and invalid domains raise ValueError. The allocation must be mathematically exact, including all ties and large integer weights.
Only seats.py may change; all other initial files and directory modes are frozen. New files are forbidden.

Run the frozen visible command `python3 -B verify.py`; do not edit verify.py. Its result is an observation, not the complete task contract. Use the controller-provided record when available and preserve its exact command/execution_state/exit_code/evidence_availability values in response checks. Return a JSON object with status (completed or blocked), findings (array), blockers (array), checks (array of exactly that one four-field check record). For implementation, successful completion has empty findings and blockers. Review findings each have path (workspace-relative POSIX, no ./), symbol (unqualified function), kind (incorrect-result, unexpected-exception or data-loss), and witness {module,function,args} drawn from the declared finite domain. A witness is a data request, never executable code. A finding must be an introduced contract violation: the baseline meets the expectation, the candidate does not. One or more supported consequences can cover the same root cause; duplicate supported findings are neutral, extra unsupported findings fail. A blocker task requires status blocked, no findings, and one blocker {resource,reason}; do not claim a pass. No extra response fields are required. Python3/standard library only. Do not install packages, change permissions or access a network. Preserve arguments to every callable.
